# USAFacts

> Non-partisan platform providing government data and statistics on US population, economy, environment, and public finances sourced from official agencies like the US Census Bureau.

USAFacts transforms government data into accessible visualizations and reports, including demographic trends, county and state statistics, and the annual Government 10-K report on taxpayer investment returns. The platform emphasizes unbiased, reliable data presentation without political spin.

## Key Topics

- US Census Bureau Population Estimates Program
- Demographic trends and population growth
- Domestic migration patterns
- County and state statistics
- Natural population change (births vs deaths)
- Immigration and migration data
- Age and racial demographics
- Government 10-K annual report
- Government finance and taxpayer investment
- Environmental and climate data
- Census data analysis
- County-level population statistics
- State-level demographic profiles

## Core Reports and Mission

- [2025 Government 10-K](https://usafacts.org/government-10-k): Annual report on government finances and return on taxpayer investment
- [US Environment Statistics](https://usafacts.org/environment): US environment data on climate, energy, natural disasters, and resources
- [Data, Undistorted](https://usafacts.org/data-undistorted): USAFacts mission: unbiased, reliable, accessible government data

## State Population Data

- [Rhode Island Population](https://usafacts.org/answers/how-many-people-live-in-the-us/state/rhode-island): Rhode Island population: 1.11M, 44th-most populous state (0.33% of US)
- [Connecticut Population](https://usafacts.org/answers/how-many-people-live-in-the-us/state/connecticut): Connecticut population: 3.69M, 29th-most populous state (1.1% of US)
- [Nevada Population](https://usafacts.org/answers/how-many-people-live-in-the-us/state/nevada): Nevada population: 3.28M, 31st-most populous state (0.96% of US)

## County Population Growth and Migration Trends

- [Sussex County, DE Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/sussex-county-de): Sussex County, DE grew 2.7% (7,200 people) via domestic migration
- [Warren County, MO Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/warren-county-mo): Warren County, MO population grew 1.8% (663 people) via domestic migration
- [Van Buren County, TN Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/van-buren-county-tn): Van Buren County, TN grew 1.7% (110 people) via domestic migration
- [Washington County, AR Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/washington-county-ar): Washington County, AR grew 1.6% (4,300 people) via immigration
- [Washita County, OK Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/washita-county-ok): Washita County, OK grew 1.1% (123 people) via domestic migration
- [Treutlen County, GA Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/treutlen-county-ga): Treutlen County, GA grew 1.1% (69 people) via domestic migration
- [Yavapai County, AZ Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/yavapai-county-az): Yavapai County, AZ grew 1% (2,500 people) via domestic migration
- [Union County, KY Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/union-county-ky): Union County, KY grew 0.47% (62 people) via domestic migration
- [Washington County, NE Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/washington-county-ne): Washington County, NE grew 0.34% (72 people) via domestic migration
- [Washington Parish, LA Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/washington-parish-la): Washington Parish, LA grew 0.31% (139 people) via domestic migration
- [Tishomingo County, MS Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/tishomingo-county-ms): Tishomingo County, MS grew 0.16% (29 people) via domestic migration
- [Washington County, PA Population Growth](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/washington-county-pa): Washington County, PA grew 0.04% (90 people) via domestic migration

## County Population Decline

- [Taney County, MO Population Decline](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/taney-county-mo): Taney County, MO population declined 0.08% due to deaths outpacing births
- [Traverse County, MN Population Decline](https://usafacts.org/answers/is-the-population-growing-or-shrinking/county/traverse-county-mn): Traverse County, MN declined 1.3% due to deaths outpacing births
